environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed as a container on AWS Lambda with a Lambda Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE (public access). The function runs with an execution role that has read/write access to the /var/task filesystem. No API Gateway or ALB in front. The function URL is directly accessible at https://<function-id>.lambda-url.<region>.on.aws/. ICU libraries version 72.1 installed in the container image (Amazon Linux 2023 base) which performs full NFKC compatibility decomposition including U+FF0F -> U+002F and U+FE52 -> U+002E mappings.
